_note: PROMPT §9: the diff classifier's own golden set — 20 labeled before/after requirement pairs drawn from realistic policy revisions across the v0 payers. The unit here is the changed requirement, which is what classifyChange() actually consumes. Labels are hand-assigned from the plain meaning of the two quotes: does the revision make the bar HARDER to satisfy (tightened), EASIER (loosened), or the same (clarified)? Deliberately includes cases the restrictiveness heuristic can get wrong — an eval that only contains easy cases measures nothing.
label: clarified

from: Clinical utility must be demonstrated through published evidence that use of the test result leads to a change in patient management that improves health outcomes
to: Clinical utility must be demonstrated through prospective studies with clinical outcomes as the endpoint
label: tightened

from: The patient has not been previously tested with the same or a comparable comprehensive genomic profiling assay for the same primary cancer diagnosis
to: Repeat testing with the same assay is permitted when there is documented disease progression, a new primary cancer, or to assess the emergence of therapy resistance mechanisms
label: loosened

from: advanced (Stage III or IV) or metastatic solid tumor cancer at the time the test is ordered
to: advanced (Stage III or IV) or metastatic solid tumor cancer at the time the test is ordered, where metastatic is defined as spread beyond regional lymph nodes
label: clarified

from: the analytical validity submission must demonstrate an analytical concordance of at least 95%
to: the analytical validity submission must demonstrate an analytical concordance of at least 98%
label: tightened

from: The member has a diagnosis of Stage IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer
to: The member has a diagnosis of Stage IIIA, IIIB or IV non-small cell lung cancer
label: loosened

from: The results will be used to select FDA-approved targeted therapy or to determine eligibility for a clinical trial
to: The ordering physician must document, prior to ordering, how the result will be used to select FDA-approved targeted therapy
label: tightened

from: Aetna considers comprehensive genomic profiling experimental and investigational for cancer screening in asymptomatic persons
to: Aetna considers comprehensive genomic profiling experimental and investigational for cancer screening in asymptomatic persons, including those with a family history of malignancy
label: tightened

from: must have an FDA approval or clearance as a companion in vitro diagnostic
to: must have an FDA approval or clearance as a companion in vitro diagnostic, or be offered by a laboratory holding a current CLIA certificate of accreditation
label: loosened

from: recurrent, relapsed, refractory, metastatic, or advanced Stage III or IV cancer
to: recurrent, relapsed, refractory, metastatic, or advanced Stage III or IV cancer, as documented in the medical record
label: clarified

from: has not been previously tested using the same NGS test for the same primary diagnosis of cancer
to: has not been previously tested using the same NGS test for the same primary diagnosis of cancer within the preceding twelve months
label: loosened

from: limited to one comprehensive genomic profiling assay per primary tumor diagnosis
to: limited to two comprehensive genomic profiling assays per primary tumor diagnosis
label: loosened

from: performed by a laboratory accredited under CLIA
to: performed by a laboratory accredited under CLIA and by the College of American Pathologists
label: tightened

from: does not cover comprehensive genomic profiling for population screening in asymptomatic individuals
to: does not cover comprehensive genomic profiling for population screening in asymptomatic individuals or for recurrence monitoring in remission
label: tightened

from: advanced or metastatic solid tumors
to: advanced or metastatic solid tumors, defined as Stage III or Stage IV per AJCC staging
label: clarified

from: ordered by the physician managing the member's oncologic care
to: ordered by a board-certified medical oncologist managing the member's care
label: tightened

from: ordered by or in consultation with a board-certified oncologist
to: ordered by a licensed physician involved in the member's cancer care
label: loosened

from: limited to one comprehensive panel per primary cancer
to: limited to one comprehensive panel per primary cancer, except where a new primary is identified
label: loosened

from: performed by a laboratory holding CLIA certification
to: performed by a laboratory holding CLIA certification and registered with the plan's designated laboratory network
label: tightened

from: documentation of the intended use of the results accompany the order
to: documentation of the intended use of the results be retained in the medical record and made available on request
label: clarified

from: clinical utility for this use has not been demonstrated in prospective outcome studies
to: clinical utility for this use may be demonstrated by peer-reviewed registry data showing a change in management
label: loosened
